verdict.rationale: Thoropass provides Unified Controls mapped across frameworks (incl. SOC), policy creation/publishing workflows, evidence request management, continuous compliance monitors, risk register, and access reviews — the core building blocks of a SOC 2 program end-to-end (docs-19,20,24,37,38,42,49,62). However, the evidence never explicitly distinguishes Type I vs Type II support or names the Trust Services Criteria directly. Missing for 10: explicit Type I/Type II workflow documentation, explicit Trust Services Criteria mapping.
